newsitem.title: GERMANY: Lufthansa Cargo reports 59.8 mln Dmk loss.
newsitem.headline: Lufthansa Cargo reports 59.8 mln Dmk loss.

text.p: Lufthansa Cargo made a pretax loss of 59.8 million marks in 1996 against a profit of 20.4 million marks in 1995, Deutsche Lufthansa AG said.
It added that the group's autonomous unit saw turnover last year rise three percent to 3.4 billion marks.
Cargo tonnage handled including freight and mail rose 4.2 percent in 1996 over 1995 to 1.68 million tonnes, while the cargo load factor grew 0.2 percentage points to 69.2 percent.
The group's annual report said that turning to the current year "the weaker mark against major currencies suggests exports would grow and demand for air cargo would grow as a result."
"In this way, Lufthansa Cargo expects a clearly improved earnings performance in 1997 with a return profit by 1998 at the latest," it added.
The report said that Lufthansa Cargo increased traffic revenue by 9.9 percent within Europe, to and from the U.S. by 7.6 percent, while to and from Asia and the Pacific revenue fell by 0.6 percent.
